f_name.expression: typ == "CORE" ? "Trend Start" : typ == "DIV" ? (sd == 1 ? "Bottom Reversal" : "Top Reversal") : typ == "HDIV" ? "Trend Continues" : typ == "PB" ? "Pullback Entry" : typ == "BRK" ? (sd == 1 ? "Breakout" : "Breakdown") : typ == "TRAP" ? (sd == 1 ? "Fake Breakdown" : "Fake Breakout") : typ == "ORB" ? (sd == 1 ? "Opening Breakout" : "Opening Breakdown") : "Big-Money Surge"

f_meaning.expression: typ == "CORE" ? "The main trend has just turned " + (sd == 1 ? "UP" : "DOWN") + ". Fresh trends often give the cleanest moves." : typ == "DIV" ? (sd == 1 ? "Price kept falling but selling pressure is fading. A bounce may be starting." : "Price kept rising but buying pressure is fading. A drop may be starting.") : typ == "HDIV" ? "A small " + (sd == 1 ? "dip" : "bounce") + " inside the trend while momentum stays healthy. The trend is likely to continue." : typ == "PB" ? "Price paused against the trend for a brick, then moved with it again. A common place to join the move." : typ == "BRK" ? "Price pushed through a recent " + (sd == 1 ? "high" : "low") + ". This often starts a stronger move." : typ == "TRAP" ? "A " + (sd == 1 ? "breakdown" : "breakout") + " failed. Traders who chased it are trapped, which can fuel a quick move the other way." : typ == "ORB" ? "Price left the first 15-minute range. This often sets the tone for the day." : "Futures volume and open interest jumped together with price. Big players look active."

f_reason.expression: typ == "CORE" ? "Supertrend turned " + (sd == 1 ? "UP" : "DOWN") + " " + str.tostring(bsf) + " brick(s) ago and this " + (sd == 1 ? "green" : "red") + " brick confirms it." : typ == "DIV" ? "RSI divergence: " + divTxt : typ == "HDIV" ? "Hidden divergence: " + divTxt : typ == "PB" ? "A pullback ended inside a " + (sd == 1 ? "UPTREND" : "DOWNTREND") + " (" + str.tostring(trendAge) + " bricks old) and the trend resumes." : typ == "BRK" ? "Price closed " + (sd == 1 ? "above the last swing high " : "below the last swing low ") + str.tostring(sd == 1 ? lastTopP : lastBotP, "#") + " while the trend agrees." : typ == "TRAP" ? (sd == 1 ? "A breakdown below " + str.tostring(trapDnLvl, "#") + " failed - price is back above it." : "A breakout above " + str.tostring(trapUpLvl, "#") + " failed - price is back below it.") : typ == "ORB" ? "Price broke the opening range (" + str.tostring(orL, "#") + " - " + str.tostring(orH, "#") + ")." : "Futures volume spike, OI build-up, VWAP and day direction all point the same way."

f_statTxt.expression: n == 0 ? "no closed trades yet" : str.tostring(n) + " trades | " + str.tostring(array.get(cW, i) * 100.0 / n, "#") + "% ended in profit | avg " + f_pc(array.get(cP, i) / n) + " | T1 reached " + str.tostring(array.get(cT1, i) * 100.0 / n, "#") + "% | T2 reached " + str.tostring(array.get(cT2, i) * 100.0 / n, "#") + "% | avg hold " + str.tostring(array.get(cB, i) * 1.0 / n, "#.#") + " bricks"

f_planTip.expression:
"TRADE PLAN (" + f_code(typ, sd, "ENTRY") + ")
Entry:     " + str.tostring(ent, "#") + "  (close of this brick)
Target 1:  " + str.tostring(t1, "#") + "  (" + (sd == 1 ? "+" : "-") + str.tostring(tgt1Pct, "#.#") + "%  =  " + str.tostring(math.round(math.abs(t1 - ent))) + " pts  =  about " + str.tostring(math.abs(t1 - ent) / boxSize, "#.#") + " bricks)
Target 2:  " + str.tostring(t2, "#") + "  (" + (sd == 1 ? "+" : "-") + str.tostring(tgt2Pct, "#.#") + "%  =  " + str.tostring(math.round(math.abs(t2 - ent))) + " pts  =  about " + str.tostring(math.abs(t2 - ent) / boxSize, "#.#") + " bricks)

HOW THE EXIT WORKS
" + f_code(typ, sd, "EXIT") + " appears when " + (exitOppN == 1 ? "the NEXT brick closes" : str.tostring(exitOppN) + " bricks close in a row") + " in the opposite colour (" + (sd == 1 ? "RED" : "GREEN") + ")" + (exitAtT2 ? ", or when Target 2 is reached." : ".") + (exitOnStop ? "
Safety exit: a brick closes " + (sd == 1 ? "below " : "above ") + str.tostring(stp, "#") + "." : "") + "
Targets are suggestions. Most exits come from the opposite-colour brick, so many trades end before Target 1.

HISTORY OF " + f_famName(f_cidx(typ, sd)) + " ON THIS CHART
" + f_statTxt(f_cidx(typ, sd))

f_exitTip.expression:
"✖ " + f_code(typ, d, "EXIT") + " " + tid + "

TRADE ID " + tid + " = the same ID that was shown on the entry arrow.

Reason: " + why + "

Entry " + str.tostring(ent, "#") + "  ->  Exit " + str.tostring(ex, "#") + "
Result: " + f_pc(pct) + "  (" + f_pts(pts) + " pts) after " + str.tostring(held) + " bricks
Target 1 (" + str.tostring(tgt1Pct, "#.#") + "%) reached: " + (t1 ? "yes" : "no") + "
Target 2 (" + str.tostring(tgt2Pct, "#.#") + "%) reached: " + (t2 ? "yes" : "no") + "

What next: wait for the next signal. Do not re-enter only because price is moving.
Guide only - not advice."

f_sigTip.expression:
(sd == 1 ? "▲ BULLISH  -  " : "▼ BEARISH  -  ") + f_family(typ) + ": " + f_name(typ, sd) + "
" + f_qual(g) + " entry  " + f_dots3(g) + "   |   Risk: " + f_riskLbl(typ, sd) + "

What it means: " + f_meaning(typ, sd) + "

Why now: " + f_reason(typ, sd) + "

Be careful: " + f_riskTxt(typ, sd) + "

Direction score " + f_pts(biasScore) + "  |  RSI " + str.tostring(rsi, "#") + (flowOk ? "  |  flow " + f_pts(flowScore) : "")
